Title: Vihaan's Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Neeta - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vihaan stands by the road. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan gets on the bus.]

Neeta (laughing): "Okay, Vihaan."

[Vihaan gets off the school bus.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

[Vihaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Neeta stands near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan catches the ball.]

Neeta (surprised): "One more time!"

[Vihaan swings on the swing.]

Vihaan: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Vihaan: "Let's see."

[Vihaan mops the floor.]

Neeta: "Vihaan, listen!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan trips over a stone.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan coughs.]

Neeta (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
